title: UK police arrest 5 by air base under terrorism act
text:
UK police arrest 5 by air base under terrorism act

Sep 27, 2026

Add AL-MONITOR on Google

A police officer blocks a road near the RAF Fairford airbase, in Fairford — Toby Shepheard

LONDON, Sept 27 (Reuters) - British police said counter-terrorism officers were leading efforts to establish what had happened at an airbase used by the US Air Force on Sunday, after they arrested five men on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act.The five men were also arrested on suspicion of committing offences under the Explosives Act. (Reporting by Kate Holton; Editing by Alexandra Hudson)
